title: Elastomer Insulated Flexible Cables for Use in Mines — Specification ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14494) covers Elastomer Insulated Flexible Cables for Use in Mines — Specification ( First Revision ). This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the the Power Cables Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electrotechnical Division Council. The standard was originally published in 1998 as a single standard for mining cables, superseding and . The first revision of this has been undertaken to update it with the present manufacturing practices and to review it with the applicable changes, if any, as per the current regulations related to flexible cables for use in mines. In this revision following major changes have been made: a) The requirement of insulation has been modified for power core, pilot and earth cores. b) The requirement of tensile strength and elongation for armour wire have been specified. c) Application of insulation for pilot core has been included. d) The colour scheme and number scheme for identification of cables has been modified. e) The requirement of dielectric power sector has been changed. f) The status of referred standards have been updated.
